description: Queries to JPL Horizons for the orientation of the Earth as seen from the Moon. Fetched once with validation/horizons/fetch.py --dir validation/earth_view; the responses are stored unchanged in raw/.

queries.what: Sub-observer point on the Earth, observer at the centre of the Moon, hourly for one week
The same every 167 hours for two years, so that every hour of the day and every season occurs
Position angle of the Moon's north pole, observer at the centre of the Earth, hourly for one week
The same every 167 hours for two years
